propositions: test_ac0_blob_ref_roundtrips_through_remote fails deterministically with git exit 128 on hosts that inject safe.bareRepository=explicit via environment variables
git -C <bare.git> refuses implicit bare repository discovery under safe.bareRepository=explicit policy, but git --git-dir <bare.git> is always permitted
the test's _git() helper uses git -C against bare fixtures for cat-file -t and rev-parse verification, triggering the refusal

the repo's own portability contract (test_bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout.py and _git_upkeep.py prior art) already establishes --git-dir as the correct pattern for bare-repo git invocations
fix route bare-remote git invocations through an explicit --git-dir helper while keeping work-tree repos on git -C
production _ref_lock code is not implicated — it never runs git -C inside a bare repository
